title: Measure the 4K HDR re-encode on the dogfood cluster's other two nodes, CPU and UHD 630
description: JS-154 measured only the 4-core node. Whether the 12- and 6-processor nodes hold the job, and whether their iGPUs decode Main 10 and tone map, is unverified. The owner approved the temporary measuring pods on both nodes on 2026-11-21 (D-045). D-044.
acceptanceCriteria: On each node, in the same kind of temporary pod as JS-154 (own namespace, GPU through the device plugin, clip copied in, deleted after): the CPU model, today's command at the pod's CPU count with CPU-seconds per second and speed, three runs
What the iGPU offers (Main 10 decode, video-processor tone map, OpenCL tone map, H.264 and HEVC encode), and the speed and CPU of hardware decode with hardware tone map and encode, with the burn-in
The hardware encode in a quality-targeted mode: bytes against x264 veryfast at equal SSIM, on a dark and on a detailed scene
Recorded in docs/transcoding.md; figures to the product owner with BL-040's promote rule answered
No viewer-visible change, and nothing in the media namespace touched
notes: Recorded in docs/transcoding.md (2026-11-21). BL-040's rule answered: holds, thinly on bytes, and silent on the tone map; no GPU tone map gives today's picture. Became JS-169 and JS-170 (D-047).
